sourceScope: Official CC0 short04 hair geometry, binding and alpha diffuse. Base anatomy and male macro-target hashes remain in source.json.

adaptation.binding: Each mhclo vertex is its three target-deformed base vertices weighted by source coefficients plus axis offsets scaled by the named source-axis landmark difference / nominal.
adaptation.headTransform: Same male head transform as build-actor-asset.mjs; all weights bind to head joint index1.
adaptation.packedFormat: IHR1: bounds-quantized uint16 positions, normalized int8 normals, uint16UVs, uint16 triangle indices.
adaptation.texture: Full image resized2048→256 LANCZOS; WebPquality76 method6 alpha_quality75 exact=True. No crop or repaint.
